sanskrit: yathā̱ manau̱ sāṁva̍raṇau̱ soma̍m i̱ndrāpi̍baḥ su̱tam | nīpā̍tithau maghava̱n medhyā̍tithau̱ puṣṭi̍gau̱ śruṣṭi̍gau̱ sacā̍ ||
english: As, O Indra, thou didst drink the pressed soma together with Manu Sāṁvaraṇa, O Maghavan, with Nīpātithi and Medhyātithi — those who bring increase, those who bring hearkening — so too now.

sanskrit: pā̱rṣa̱dvā̱ṇaḥ praska̍ṇva̱ṁ sam a̍sādaya̱c chayā̍na̱ṁ jivri̱m uddhi̍tam | sa̱hasrā̍ṇy asiṣāsa̱d gavā̱m ṛṣi̱s tvoto̱ dasya̍ve̱ vṛka̍ḥ ||
english: Pārṣadvāṇa caused Praskañva, who had lain down, the withered and emaciated man, to sit upright; the seer, aided by thee, O Indra, like a wolf to the Dasyu, gained thousands of cattle.

sanskrit: ya u̱kthebhi̱r na vi̱ndhate̍ ci̱kid ya ṛ̍ṣi̱coda̍naḥ | indra̱ṁ tam acchā̍ vada̱ navya̍syā ma̱ty ari̍ṣyanta̱ṁ na bhoja̍se ||
english: He who gains nothing whatsoever by his recitations, he who is stirred to verse — speak toward that Indra with a fresh thought, the one who suffers no harm, for the sake of bounty.

sanskrit: yasmā̍ a̱rkaṁ sa̱ptaśī̍rṣāṇam ānṛ̱cus tri̱dhātu̍m utta̱me pa̱de | sa tv i1̱̍mā viśvā̱ bhuva̍nāni cikrada̱d ād ij ja̍niṣṭa̱ pauṁsya̍m ||
english: He for whom they have sung the hymn of seven heads, of triple substance, in the highest station — he has roared over all these worlds; thereby his manly vigour was born anew.

sanskrit: yo no̍ dā̱tā vasū̍nā̱m indra̱ṁ taṁ hū̍mahe va̱yam | vi̱dmā hy a̍sya suma̱tiṁ navī̍yasīṁ ga̱mema̱ goma̍ti vra̱je ||
english: We call upon that Indra who is the giver of good things to us; for we know his latest favour — may we reach the cow-filled stall.

sanskrit: yasmai̱ tvaṁ va̍so dā̱nāya̱ śikṣa̍si̱ sa rā̱yas poṣa̍m aśnute | taṁ tvā̍ va̱yam ma̍ghavann indra girvaṇaḥ su̱tāva̍nto havāmahe ||
english: He to whom thou, O Vasu, dost extend thy giving, he obtains the fullness of wealth; thee, O Maghavan Indra, O lover of hymns, we who have pressed soma now invoke.

sanskrit: ka̱dā ca̱na sta̱rīr a̍si̱ nendra̍ saścasi dā̱śuṣe̍ | upo̱pen nu ma̍ghava̱n bhūya̱ in nu te̱ dāna̍ṁ de̱vasya̍ pṛcyate ||
english: You are never barren, O Indra; you do not abandon the worshipper. Step forth, O Maghavan, step forth again — then once more is the gift of the god sought.

sanskrit: pra yo na̍na̱kṣe a̱bhy oja̍sā̱ krivi̍ṁ va̱dhaiḥ śuṣṇa̍ṁ nigho̱ṣaya̍n | ya̱ded asta̍mbhīt pra̱thaya̍nn a̱mūṁ diva̱m ād ij ja̍niṣṭa̱ pārthi̍vaḥ ||
english: He who pressed eagerly forward with might against Kriви, driving Śuṣṇa to his ruin with his blows, who propped up yonder sky while spreading it wide — thereby the earthly hero was born.

sanskrit: yasyā̱yaṁ viśva̱ āryo̱ dāsa̍ḥ śevadhi̱pā a̱riḥ | ti̱raś ci̍d a̱rye ruśa̍me̱ parī̍ravi̱ tubhyet so a̍jyate ra̱yiḥ ||
english: He whose is this whole world — the Ārya, the Dāsa, the guardian of treasures, the foe — even through the Ārya, through Ruśama, the wealth that resounds is driven toward thee.

sanskrit: tu̱ra̱ṇyavo̱ madhu̍mantaṁ ghṛta̱ścuta̱ṁ viprā̍so a̱rkam ā̍nṛcuḥ | a̱sme ra̱yiḥ pa̍prathe̱ vṛṣṇya̱ṁ śavo̱ 'sme su̍vā̱nāsa̱ inda̍vaḥ ||
english: The swift, inspired sages have sung the hymn that drips with honey and ghee; in us the wealth and the bull-like power have spread wide; in us the pressed soma-drops flow.

sanskrit: yathā̱ manau̱ viva̍svati̱ soma̍ṁ śa̱krāpi̍baḥ su̱tam | yathā̍ tri̱te chanda̍ indra̱ jujo̍ṣasy ā̱yau mā̍dayase̱ sacā̍ ||
english: As, O Śakra, thou didst drink the pressed soma with Manu Vivasvat, as, O Indra, thou hast found pleasure in the metre at Trita's side — exhilarate thyself there.

sanskrit: pṛṣa̍dhre̱ medhye̍ māta̱riśva̱nīndra̍ suvā̱ne ama̍ndathāḥ | yathā̱ soma̱ṁ daśa̍śipre̱ daśo̍ṇye̱ syūma̍raśmā̱v ṛjū̍nasi ||
english: At Pṛṣadhra's pressing, O Indra, with Mātariśvan, thou wast exhilarated; as with the soma at Daśaśipra's, at Daśoṇya's, at Syūmaraśman's side — thou art the straightener.

sanskrit: ya u̱kthā keva̍lā da̱dhe yaḥ soma̍ṁ dhṛṣi̱tāpi̍bat | yasmai̱ viṣṇu̱s trīṇi̍ pa̱dā vi̍cakra̱ma upa̍ mi̱trasya̱ dharma̍bhiḥ ||
english: He who alone has upheld the recitations, who has boldly drunk the soma, for whom Viṣṇu strode his three strides in accordance with Mitra's ordinances.

sanskrit: yasya̱ tvam i̍ndra̱ stome̍ṣu cā̱kano̱ vāje̍ vājiñ chatakrato | taṁ tvā̍ va̱yaṁ su̱dughā̍m iva go̱duho̍ juhū̱masi̍ śrava̱syava̍ḥ ||
english: Him in whose praises thou, O Indra, dost delight — thee, O prize-winner, O hundred-powered one — thee we invoke like cowherds milking a good milch-cow, we who are eager for renown.

sanskrit: yo no̍ dā̱tā sa na̍ḥ pi̱tā ma̱hām̐ u̱gra ī̍śāna̱kṛt | ayā̍mann u̱gro ma̱ghavā̍ purū̱vasu̱r gor aśva̍sya̱ pra dā̍tu naḥ ||
english: He who is our giver is our father, mighty, fierce, the ruler of rulers; the fierce Maghavan of many treasures, ever moving — may he give to us cattle and horses.

sanskrit: yasmai̱ tvaṁ va̍so dā̱nāya̱ maṁha̍se̱ sa rā̱yas poṣa̍m invati | va̱sū̱yavo̱ vasu̍patiṁ śa̱takra̍tu̱ṁ stomai̱r indra̍ṁ havāmahe ||
english: He to whom thou, O Vasu, dost pour out thyself in giving, he sets wealth growing; we who desire goods invoke with praises Indra, the lord of goods, the hundred-powered.

sanskrit: ka̱dā ca̱na pra yu̍cchasy u̱bhe ni pā̍si̱ janma̍nī | turī̍yāditya̱ hava̍naṁ ta indri̱yam ā ta̍sthāv a̱mṛta̍ṁ di̱vi ||
english: Thou dost never fail: thou guardest both births. O fourth Āditya, thy mighty power has taken its stand at thy invocation, the immortal one in the sky.

sanskrit: yasmai̱ tvam ma̍ghavann indra girvaṇa̱ḥ śikṣo̱ śikṣa̍si dā̱śuṣe̍ | a̱smāka̱ṁ gira̍ u̱ta su̍ṣṭu̱tiṁ va̍so kaṇva̱vac chṛ̍ṇudhī̱ hava̍m ||
english: To whomsoever thou, O Maghavan Indra, O lover of hymns, dost impart thy giving for the worshipper — hear our songs and our excellent praise, O Vasu, as for Kaṇva, hear our call.

sanskrit: astā̍vi̱ manma̍ pū̱rvyam brahmendrā̍ya vocata | pū̱rvīr ṛ̱tasya̍ bṛha̱tīr a̍nūṣata sto̱tur me̱dhā a̍sṛkṣata ||
english: The ancient prayer has been praised; speak forth the sacred formula to Indra; the many great ones of Ṛta have sung in response; the wisdom of the praiser has been poured forth.

sanskrit: sam indro̱ rāyo̍ bṛha̱tīr a̍dhūnuta̱ saṁ kṣo̱ṇī sam u̱ sūrya̍m | saṁ śu̱krāsa̱ḥ śuca̍ya̱ḥ saṁ gavāśira̱ḥ somā̱ indra̍m amandiṣuḥ ||
english: Indra shook together the great riches, shook together the two worlds, shook together also the sun; the bright, pure soma-draughts mixed with milk have rejoiced Indra together.

sanskrit: u̱pa̱maṁ tvā̍ ma̱ghonā̱ṁ jyeṣṭha̍ṁ ca vṛṣa̱bhāṇā̍m | pū̱rbhitta̍mam maghavann indra go̱vida̱m īśā̍naṁ rā̱ya ī̍mahe ||
english: Thee, the highest of the bountiful ones and the greatest of the bulls, the most fort-breaking, O Maghavan Indra, the finder of cattle, the lord of wealth — thee we implore.

sanskrit: ya ā̱yuṁ kutsa̍m atithi̱gvam arda̍yo vāvṛdhā̱no di̱ve-di̍ve | taṁ tvā̍ va̱yaṁ harya̍śvaṁ śa̱takra̍tuṁ vāja̱yanto̍ havāmahe ||
english: Who, growing great day by day, subdued Āyu, Kutsa, and Atithigva — thee, of the bay horses and the hundred powers, we invoke as we seek the prize.

sanskrit: ā no̱ viśve̍ṣā̱ṁ rasa̱m madhva̍ḥ siñca̱ntv adra̍yaḥ | ye pa̍rā̱vati̍ sunvi̱re jane̱ṣv ā ye a̍rvā̱vatīnda̍vaḥ ||
english: Let the pressing-stones pour for us the essence of all the sweets — those soma-drops that have been pressed among distant peoples and those that have been pressed among the near ones.

sanskrit: viśvā̱ dveṣā̍ṁsi ja̱hi cāva̱ cā kṛ̍dhi̱ viśve̍ sanva̱ntv ā vasu̍ | śīṣṭe̍ṣu cit te madi̱rāso̍ a̱ṁśavo̱ yatrā̱ soma̍sya tṛ̱mpasi̍ ||
english: Smite all enmities and drive them away; let all bring good things; even among the highest, thy inebriating soma-stalks rejoice thee, wherever thou art satiated with the soma.

sanskrit: indra̱ nedī̍ya̱ ed i̍hi mi̱tame̍dhābhir ū̱tibhi̍ḥ | ā śa̍ṁtama̱ śaṁta̍mābhir a̱bhiṣṭi̍bhi̱r ā svā̍pe svā̱pibhi̍ḥ ||
english: Come here yet nearer, O Indra, with helps measured by wisdom; with the most beneficent conquests, with the most good, come with good sleeps, with good sleep-bringers.

sanskrit: ā̱ji̱tura̱ṁ satpa̍tiṁ vi̱śvaca̍rṣaṇiṁ kṛ̱dhi pra̱jāsv ābha̍gam | pra sū ti̍rā̱ śacī̍bhi̱r ye ta̍ u̱kthina̱ḥ kratu̍m puna̱ta ā̍nu̱ṣak ||
english: Make the swift-racer, lord of the good, he who is seen by all peoples, share of offspring; speed them forward with thy powers who are thy reciters and who purify understanding in succession.

sanskrit: yas te̱ sādhi̱ṣṭho 'va̍se̱ te syā̍ma̱ bhare̍ṣu te | va̱yaṁ hotrā̍bhir u̱ta de̱vahū̍tibhiḥ sasa̱vāṁso̍ manāmahe ||
english: May we be of those most favourably disposed toward thee, for help in thy battles; we, having won, exult with the priestly calls and with invocations of the gods.

sanskrit: a̱haṁ hi te̍ harivo̱ brahma̍ vāja̱yur ā̱jiṁ yāmi̱ sado̱tibhi̍ḥ | tvām id e̱va tam ame̱ sam a̍śva̱yur ga̱vyur agre̍ mathī̱nām ||
english: For I, O lord of the bay steeds, go with thy prayer eager for the prize, to the contest with ever-present helps; thee, even thee I urge, the eager seeker of horses, seeker of cattle, at the fore of the contests.

sanskrit: e̱tat ta̍ indra vī̱rya̍ṁ gī̱rbhir gṛ̱ṇanti̍ kā̱rava̍ḥ | te stobha̍nta̱ ūrja̍m āvan ghṛta̱ścuta̍m pau̱rāso̍ nakṣan dhī̱tibhi̍ḥ ||
english: This heroic power of thine the Kārus celebrate with songs; they who offer invocations have gone to the ghee-dripping strength; the singers of the family of Pūru have gained it with their devotions.

sanskrit: nakṣa̍nta̱ indra̱m ava̍se sukṛ̱tyayā̱ yeṣā̍ṁ su̱teṣu̱ manda̍se | yathā̍ saṁva̱rte ama̍do̱ yathā̍ kṛ̱śa e̱vāsme i̍ndra matsva ||
english: Those who by good work sought Indra for aid, at whose pressings thou dost exhilarate thyself — as thou wast exhilarated at Saṁvarta's, as at Kṛśa's — even so, O Indra, rejoice in us.

sanskrit: ā no̱ viśve̍ sa̱joṣa̍so̱ devā̍so̱ ganta̱nopa̍ naḥ | vasa̍vo ru̱drā ava̍se na̱ ā ga̍mañ chṛ̱ṇvantu̍ ma̱ruto̱ hava̍m ||
english: Come all of you, O gods, equally pleased, come near to us; let the Vasus and Rudras come to us for help; let the Maruts hear our call.

sanskrit: pū̱ṣā viṣṇu̱r hava̍nam me̱ sara̍sva̱ty ava̍ntu sa̱pta sindha̍vaḥ | āpo̱ vāta̱ḥ parva̍tāso̱ vana̱spati̍ḥ śṛ̱ṇotu̍ pṛthi̱vī hava̍m ||
english: May Pūṣan, Viṣṇu, Sarasvatī, the seven rivers strengthen my call; may the Waters, Vāta, the mountains, the forest lord, and Earth hear the invocation.

sanskrit: yad i̍ndra̱ rādho̱ asti̍ te̱ māgho̍nam maghavattama | tena̍ no bodhi sadha̱mādyo̍ vṛ̱dhe bhago̍ dā̱nāya̍ vṛtrahan ||
english: Whatever bounty is thine, O Indra, the very best of gifts, O most bountiful one — with that be aware of us, O thou who dost enjoy thy feast, for our increase, as our share, for giving, O Vṛtra-slayer.

sanskrit: āji̍pate nṛpate̱ tvam id dhi no̱ vāja̱ ā va̍kṣi sukrato | vī̱tī hotrā̍bhir u̱ta de̱vavī̍tibhiḥ sasa̱vāṁso̱ vi śṛ̍ṇvire ||
english: O lord of the contest, lord of heroes, thou indeed wilt carry the prize to us, O wise one; having won through the priestly calls and through the divine repasts, they will be heard.

sanskrit: santi̱ hy a1̱̍rya ā̱śiṣa̱ indra̱ āyu̱r janā̍nām | a̱smān na̍kṣasva maghava̱nn upāva̍se dhu̱kṣasva̍ pi̱pyuṣī̱m iṣa̍m ||
english: For there are the noble blessings of the people's life, O Indra; seek us out, O Maghavan, for our help close at hand; milk out the swelling refreshment.

sanskrit: va̱yaṁ ta̍ indra̱ stome̍bhir vidhema̱ tvam a̱smāka̍ṁ śatakrato | mahi̍ sthū̱raṁ śa̍śa̱yaṁ rādho̱ ahra̍ya̱m praska̍ṇvāya̱ ni to̍śaya ||
english: May we honour thee, O Indra, with our praises; be thou ours, O hundred-powered one; pour out for Praskañva the great, abundant, dispersed, and shameless bounty.

sanskrit: bhūrīd indra̍sya vī̱rya1̱̍ṁ vy akhya̍m a̱bhy āya̍ti | rādha̍s te dasyave vṛka ||
english: I have beheld the many heroic deeds of Indra as he comes forward; thy bounty, O wolf to the Dasyu, is great.

sanskrit: śa̱taṁ śve̱tāsa̍ u̱kṣaṇo̍ di̱vi tāro̱ na ro̍cante | ma̱hnā diva̱ṁ na ta̍stabhuḥ ||
english: A hundred white bulls shine in the sky like stars; they have propped up the sky with their greatness.

sanskrit: śa̱taṁ ve̱ṇūñ cha̱taṁ śuna̍ḥ śa̱taṁ carmā̍ṇi mlā̱tāni̍ | śa̱tam me̍ balbajastu̱kā aru̍ṣīṇā̱ṁ catu̍ḥśatam ||
english: A hundred bamboo tubes, a hundred dogs, a hundred worn skins; for me a hundred bundles of balvaja-grass and four hundred reddish cows.

sanskrit: su̱de̱vāḥ stha̍ kāṇvāyanā̱ vayo̍-vayo vica̱ranta̍ḥ | aśvā̍so̱ na ca̍ṅkramata ||
english: You are of the good gods' company, O descendants of Kāṇva, wandering each according to your nature; you move about like horses.

sanskrit: ād it sā̱ptasya̍ carkira̱nn ānū̍nasya̱ mahi̱ śrava̍ḥ | śyāvī̍r atidhva̱san pa̱thaś cakṣu̍ṣā ca̱na sa̱ṁnaśe̍ ||
english: And they have made resound the great fame of Sāptasa, the complete one; the dark-hued mare, outpacing the roads, could not be reached even by the eye.

sanskrit: prati̍ te dasyave vṛka̱ rādho̍ ada̱rśy ahra̍yam | dyaur na pra̍thi̱nā śava̍ḥ ||
english: For thee, O wolf to the Dasyu, the shameless bounty has been seen spread out; the power is broad as the sky.

sanskrit: daśa̱ mahya̍m pautakra̱taḥ sa̱hasrā̱ dasya̍ve̱ vṛka̍ḥ ||
english: Ten thousands of (cattle) have been given to me by Pautakrata, the wolf to the Dasyu.

sanskrit: śa̱tam me̍ garda̱bhānā̍ṁ śa̱tam ūrṇā̍vatīnām | śa̱taṁ dā̱sām̐ ati̱ sraja̍ḥ ||
english: A hundred asses for me, a hundred woollen (ewes), a hundred female slaves — beyond reckoning.

sanskrit: tatro̱ api̱ prāṇī̍yata pū̱takra̍tāyai̱ vya̍ktā | aśvā̍nā̱m in na yū̱thyā̍m ||
english: Moreover, distinguishable ones were led forward for Pūtakratā — like a troop of horses indeed.

sanskrit: ace̍ty a̱gniś ci̍ki̱tur ha̍vya̱vāṭ sa su̱madra̍thaḥ | a̱gniḥ śu̱kreṇa̍ śo̱ciṣā̍ bṛ̱hat sūro̍ arocata di̱vi sūryo̍ arocata ||
english: Agni, the conveyor of oblations, the discerning one, became known; he of the good chariot — Agni blazed mightily with his bright flame; the sun shone in the sky, the sun shone bright.

sanskrit: yu̱vaṁ de̍vā̱ kratu̍nā pū̱rvyeṇa̍ yu̱ktā rathe̍na tavi̱ṣaṁ ya̍jatrā | āga̍cchataṁ nāsatyā̱ śacī̍bhir i̱daṁ tṛ̱tīya̱ṁ sava̍nam pibāthaḥ ||
english: You two gods, yoked by the ancient will to your mighty chariot, O adorable Nāsatyās, come hither with your powers; drink this, the third pressing.

sanskrit: yu̱vāṁ de̱vās traya̍ ekāda̱śāsa̍ḥ sa̱tyāḥ sa̱tyasya̍ dadṛśe pu̱rastā̍t | a̱smāka̍ṁ ya̱jñaṁ sava̍naṁ juṣā̱ṇā pā̱taṁ soma̍m aśvinā̱ dīdya̍gnī ||
english: The gods, the true ones, the three and thirty, have been seen before the truth of you two; enjoying our sacrifice and pressing, O Aśvins of blazing fire, drink the soma.

sanskrit: pa̱nāyya̱ṁ tad a̍śvinā kṛ̱taṁ vā̍ṁ vṛṣa̱bho di̱vo raja̍saḥ pṛthi̱vyāḥ | sa̱hasra̱ṁ śaṁsā̍ u̱ta ye gavi̍ṣṭau̱ sarvā̱m̐ it tām̐ upa̍ yātā̱ piba̍dhyai ||
english: Praiseworthy is that work of yours, O Aśvins; the bull of sky and earth's expanse — a thousand praises and those in the contest for cattle — come to all of these to drink.

sanskrit: a̱yaṁ vā̍m bhā̱go nihi̍to yajatre̱mā giro̍ nāsa̱tyopa̍ yātam | piba̍ta̱ṁ soma̱m madhu̍mantam a̱sme pra dā̱śvāṁsa̍m avata̱ṁ śacī̍bhiḥ ||
english: This is your appointed share, O adorable ones; come hither to these songs, O Nāsatyās; drink the sweet honey-soma among us; protect the offerer with your powers.

sanskrit: yam ṛ̱tvijo̍ bahu̱dhā ka̱lpaya̍nta̱ḥ sace̍taso ya̱jñam i̱maṁ vaha̍nti | yo a̍nūcā̱no brā̍hma̱ṇo yu̱kta ā̍sī̱t kā svi̱t tatra̱ yaja̍mānaśya sa̱ṁvit ||
english: Him whom the priests, making manifold preparations, bearing this sacrifice in concert, for whom the instructed Brahmin was engaged — what indeed was the understanding of the sacrificer therein?

sanskrit: eka̍ e̱vāgnir ba̍hu̱dhā sami̍ddha̱ eka̱ḥ sūryo̱ viśva̱m anu̱ prabhū̍taḥ | ekai̱voṣāḥ sarva̍m i̱daṁ vi bhā̱ty eka̱ṁ vā i̱daṁ vi ba̍bhūva̱ sarva̍m ||
english: One indeed is Agni, kindled in many places; one is the Sun, who pervades all the world; one is Dawn that illumines all this — that one has verily become all this universe.

sanskrit: jyoti̍ṣmantaṁ ketu̱manta̍ṁ trica̱kraṁ su̱khaṁ ratha̍ṁ su̱ṣada̱m bhūri̍vāram | ci̱trāma̍ghā̱ yasya̱ yoge̍ 'dhijajñe̱ taṁ vā̍ṁ hu̱ve ati̍ rikta̱m piba̍dhyai ||
english: The luminous, the radiant, the three-wheeled, comfortable chariot, easy to sit in, much sought — she of brilliant gifts, she who was born at the yoking of it — that chariot I call for you two, beyond measure, to drink.

sanskrit: i̱māni̍ vām bhāga̱dheyā̍ni sisrata̱ indrā̍varuṇā̱ pra ma̱he su̱teṣu̍ vām | ya̱jñe-ya̍jñe ha̱ sava̍nā bhura̱ṇyatho̱ yat su̍nva̱te yaja̍mānaśya̱ śikṣa̍thaḥ ||
english: These your apportioned shares flow forth for you two, O Indra and Varuṇa, at your great soma-pressings; at sacrifice after sacrifice, at the pressings, you are active; when you aid the sacrificer who presses soma.

sanskrit: ni̱ṣṣidhva̍rī̱r oṣa̍dhī̱r āpa̍ āstā̱m indrā̍varuṇā mahi̱māna̱m āśa̍ta | yā sisra̍tū̱ raja̍saḥ pā̱re adhva̍no̱ yayo̱ḥ śatru̱r naki̱r āde̍va̱ oha̍te ||
english: The herbs that block and the waters have been laid ready; O Indra and Varuṇa, they have reached greatness; those two who flow at the end of the expanse of the path — of these two, no enemy, no ungodly one, escapes.

sanskrit: sa̱tyaṁ tad i̍ndrāvaruṇā kṛ̱śasya̍ vā̱m madhva̍ ū̱rmiṁ du̍hate sa̱pta vāṇī̍ḥ | tābhi̍r dā̱śvāṁsa̍m avataṁ śubhas patī̱ yo vā̱m ada̍bdho a̱bhi pāti̱ citti̍bhiḥ ||
english: True is this, O Indra and Varuṇa: for the diminished Kṛśa the seven voices milk out a wave of your sweetness; with those, O lords of splendour, protect the worshipper who, undeceived, guards you with his thoughts.

sanskrit: ghṛ̱ta̱pruṣa̱ḥ saumyā̍ jī̱radā̍navaḥ sa̱pta svasā̍ra̱ḥ sada̍na ṛ̱tasya̍ | yā ha̍ vām indrāvaruṇā ghṛta̱ścuta̱s tābhi̍r dhatta̱ṁ yaja̍mānaśya śikṣatam ||
english: The ghee-sprinkling, soma-born, swift-giving, seven sisters that are the seat of Ṛta — those that drip ghee for you two, O Indra and Varuṇa — with those bestow and give instruction to the sacrificer.

sanskrit: avo̍cāma maha̱te saubha̍gāya sa̱tyaṁ tve̱ṣābhyā̍m mahi̱māna̍m indri̱yam | a̱smān sv i̍ndrāvaruṇā ghṛta̱ścuta̱s tribhi̍ḥ sā̱ptebhi̍r avataṁ śubhas patī ||
english: We have spoken the true great power of the mighty sense to the two brilliant ones for great good fortune; protect us well, O Indra and Varuṇa, you who are ghee-dripping, with three times seven, O lords of splendour.

sanskrit: indrā̍varuṇā̱ yad ṛ̱ṣibhyo̍ manī̱ṣāṁ vā̱co ma̱tiṁ śru̱tam a̍datta̱m agre̍ | yāni̱ sthānā̍ny asṛjanta̱ dhīrā̍ ya̱jñaṁ ta̍nvā̱nās tapa̍sā̱bhy a̍paśyam ||
english: O Indra and Varuṇa, what inspired wisdom, speech, thought, and sacred knowledge you gave to the seers at the beginning — those stations which the wise ones created, spreading the sacrifice with fervent devotion — those I have perceived.

sanskrit: indrā̍varuṇā saumana̱sam adṛ̍ptaṁ rā̱yas poṣa̱ṁ yaja̍māneṣu dhattam | pra̱jām pu̱ṣṭim bhū̍tim a̱smāsu̍ dhattaṁ dīrghāyu̱tvāya̱ pra ti̍rataṁ na̱ āyu̍ḥ ||
english: O Indra and Varuṇa, bestow on the sacrificers an unhaughty benevolence and the flourishing of wealth; bestow offspring, nourishment, and prosperity on us; extend our lifespan for longevity.

sanskrit: agna̱ ā yā̍hy a̱gnibhi̱r hotā̍raṁ tvā vṛṇīmahe | ā tvām a̍naktu̱ praya̍tā ha̱viṣma̍tī̱ yaji̍ṣṭham ba̱rhir ā̱sade̍ ||
english: Come, O Agni, with the fires; we choose thee as the Hotṛ-priest; let the well-extended oblation-bearing ladle anoint thee, the most adorable, to sit upon the barhis-grass.

sanskrit: acchā̱ hi tvā̍ sahasaḥ sūno aṅgira̱ḥ sruca̱ś cara̍nty adhva̱re | ū̱rjo napā̍taṁ ghṛ̱take̍śam īmahe̱ 'gniṁ ya̱jñeṣu̍ pū̱rvyam ||
english: For toward thee, O son of strength, O Aṅgiras, the ladles move in the sacrifice; we implore Agni the grandson of strength, of ghee-bright hair, the ancient one at sacrifices.

sanskrit: agne̍ ka̱vir ve̍dhā a̍si̱ hotā̍ pāvaka̱ yakṣya̍ḥ | ma̱ndro yaji̍ṣṭho adhva̱reṣv īḍyo̱ vipre̍bhiḥ śukra̱ manma̍bhiḥ ||
english: O Agni, thou art the sage, the ordainer, the Hotṛ, the purifier, worthy of worship; the joyful one, the most adorable at the ceremonies, worthy of praise by the inspired with bright hymns.

sanskrit: adro̍gha̱m ā va̍hośa̱to ya̍viṣṭhya de̱vām̐ a̍jasra vī̱taye̍ | a̱bhi prayā̍ṁsi̱ sudhi̱tā va̍so gahi̱ manda̍sva dhī̱tibhi̍r hi̱taḥ ||
english: Bring hither the blameless gods, O youngest one, continually for the feast, to the longing ones; go to the well-placed offerings, O Vasu; be thou gladdened, stirred by the devotions.

sanskrit: tvam it sa̱prathā̍ a̱sy agne̍ trātar ṛ̱tas ka̱viḥ | tvāṁ viprā̍saḥ samidhāna dīdi̱va ā vi̍vāsanti ve̱dhasa̍ḥ ||
english: Thou indeed art far-famed, O Agni, protector of Ṛta, the seer; thee, O kindled and blazing one, the inspired ordaining priests come to revere.

sanskrit: śocā̍ śociṣṭha dīdi̱hi vi̱śe mayo̱ rāsva̍ sto̱tre ma̱hām̐ a̍si | de̱vānā̱ṁ śarma̱n mama̍ santu sū̱raya̍ḥ śatrū̱ṣāha̍ḥ sva̱gnaya̍ḥ ||
english: Blaze, O most blazing one; shine; grant comfort to the clan, O thou who art great for the praiser; may my patrons be in the shelter of the gods, conquerors of enemies, of good fire.

sanskrit: yathā̍ cid vṛ̱ddham a̍ta̱sam agne̍ sa̱ṁjūrva̍si̱ kṣami̍ | e̱vā da̍ha mitramaho̱ yo a̍sma̱dhrug du̱rmanmā̱ kaś ca̱ vena̍ti ||
english: As, O Agni, thou dost consume on the ground the aged stubble grown thick, so burn, O thou of mighty alliance, whoever plots against us, whoever of evil mind desires to harm.

sanskrit: mā no̱ martā̍ya ri̱pave̍ rakṣa̱svine̱ māghaśa̍ṁsāya rīradhaḥ | asre̍dhadbhis ta̱raṇi̍bhir yaviṣṭhya śi̱vebhi̍ḥ pāhi pā̱yubhi̍ḥ ||
english: Do not deliver us to the mortal enemy, to the rakṣas-afflicted, to the evil-speaking one; protect us, O youngest one, with unfailing, crossing, auspicious guardians.

sanskrit: pā̱hi no̍ agna̱ eka̍yā pā̱hy u1̱̍ta dvi̱tīya̍yā | pā̱hi gī̱rbhis ti̱sṛbhi̍r ūrjām pate pā̱hi ca̍ta̱sṛbhi̍r vaso ||
english: Protect us, O Agni, with one protection; protect us also with a second; protect us with three songs, O lord of vigour; protect us with four, O Vasu.

sanskrit: pā̱hi viśva̍smād ra̱kṣaso̱ arā̍vṇa̱ḥ pra sma̱ vāje̍ṣu no 'va | tvām id dhi nedi̍ṣṭhaṁ de̱vatā̍taya ā̱piṁ nakṣā̍mahe vṛ̱dhe ||
english: Protect us from every rākṣasa, from the ungenerous; ever help us in the contests; for thee, the nearest, we seek as our ally and kinsman for increase, through the divine companionship.

sanskrit: ā no̍ agne vayo̱vṛdha̍ṁ ra̱yim pā̍vaka̱ śaṁsya̍m | rāsvā̍ ca na upamāte puru̱spṛha̱ṁ sunī̍tī̱ svaya̍śastaram ||
english: Bring to us, O Agni, the wealth that enhances vigour, O purifier, worthy of praise; O incomparable, grant us too the much-desired gift, the one of good guidance that is its own glory.

sanskrit: yena̱ vaṁsā̍ma̱ pṛta̍nāsu̱ śardha̍ta̱s tara̍nto a̱rya ā̱diśa̍ḥ | sa tvaṁ no̍ vardha̱ praya̍sā śacīvaso̱ jinvā̱ dhiyo̍ vasu̱vida̍ḥ ||
english: With which we may overcome the proud ones in battles, crossing the enemy's attacks — with that, O thou of mighty power, increase us with refreshment; incite the thoughts that find good things.

sanskrit: śiśā̍no vṛṣa̱bho ya̍thā̱gniḥ śṛṅge̱ davi̍dhvat | ti̱gmā a̍sya̱ hana̍vo̱ na pra̍ti̱dhṛṣe̍ su̱jambha̱ḥ saha̍so ya̱huḥ ||
english: Sharpening himself like a bull, Agni waves his horns; his sharp jaws are not to be resisted; the offspring of strength, of good teeth, leaps up.

sanskrit: na̱hi te̍ agne vṛṣabha prati̱dhṛṣe̱ jambhā̍so̱ yad vi̱tiṣṭha̍se | sa tvaṁ no̍ hota̱ḥ suhu̍taṁ ha̱viṣ kṛ̍dhi̱ vaṁsvā̍ no̱ vāryā̍ pu̱ru ||
english: There is no resisting thy jaws, O Agni, O bull, when thou spreadest wide; thou as our Hotṛ make our oblation well-offered; win for us many desirable things.

sanskrit: śeṣe̱ vane̍ṣu mā̱troḥ saṁ tvā̱ martā̍sa indhate | ata̍ndro ha̱vyā va̍hasi havi̱ṣkṛta̱ ād id de̱veṣu̍ rājasi ||
english: Thou dost lie in the forests, the child of two mothers; mortals kindle thee together; unwearied, thou dost carry the oblations, the oblation-maker, and then thou reignest among the gods.

sanskrit: sa̱pta hotā̍ra̱s tam id ī̍ḻate̱ tvāgne̍ su̱tyaja̱m ahra̍yam | bhi̱natsy adri̱ṁ tapa̍sā̱ vi śo̱ciṣā̱ prāgne̍ tiṣṭha̱ janā̱m̐ ati̍ ||
english: The seven Hotṛ-priests praise thee, O Agni, thou who art easily released and shameless; thou dost split the rock with thy heat, with thy blazing; go forward, O Agni, beyond the peoples.

sanskrit: a̱gnim-a̍gniṁ vo̱ adhri̍guṁ hu̱vema̍ vṛ̱ktaba̍rhiṣaḥ | a̱gniṁ hi̱tapra̍yasaḥ śaśva̱tīṣv ā hotā̍raṁ carṣaṇī̱nām ||
english: We invoke for you Agni upon Agni, the irresistible, we who have strewn the barhis; Agni with offerings placed, at all times, the Hotṛ-priest of the peoples.

sanskrit: kete̍na̱ śarma̱n sacate suṣā̱maṇy agne̱ tubhya̍ṁ ciki̱tvanā̍ | i̱ṣa̱ṇyayā̍ naḥ puru̱rūpa̱m ā bha̍ra̱ vāja̱ṁ nedi̍ṣṭham ū̱taye̍ ||
english: He follows your shelter with understanding, O Agni, discerningly, with good praises; with impelling zeal bring to us the prize of many forms, the nearest, for our aid.

sanskrit: agne̱ jari̍tar vi̱śpati̍s tepā̱no de̍va ra̱kṣasa̍ḥ | apro̍ṣivān gṛ̱hapa̍tir ma̱hām̐ a̍si di̱vas pā̱yur du̍roṇa̱yuḥ ||
english: O Agni, O praiser, thou art the lord of the settlement, the scorcher of the rākṣasas, O god; not having stayed away, thou art the great lord of the house, the guardian of the sky, who remains in the dwelling.

sanskrit: mā no̱ rakṣa̱ ā ve̍śīd āghṛṇīvaso̱ mā yā̱tur yā̍tu̱māva̍tām | pa̱ro̱ga̱vyū̱ty ani̍rā̱m apa̱ kṣudha̱m agne̱ sedha̍ rakṣa̱svina̍ḥ ||
english: Let no rākṣasa enter us, O glowing Vasu; let not the sorcerers with their magic afflict us; drive far away the want beyond the extent of the pasture, drive away hunger, O Agni; repel those afflicted by rākṣasas.
